research_question: Catalog polymeric entities shown to cross the blood-brain barrier (classification)

fields.name: polymer_bigsmiles
fields.definition: polymer identity in BigSMILES; CRIPT/PoLyInfo xref where available

fields.name: surface_modification
fields.definition: PEGylation / targeting ligand / coating (free text + controlled where possible)

fields.name: cargo
fields.definition: drug/gene payload as SMILES+InChIKey or biologic id; null if unloaded

fields.name: assay
fields.definition: the assay that produced the crossing evidence

fields.name: evidence_tier
fields.definition: directness tier of the assay (T1 strongest ... T6 in silico)

fields.name: crosses_bbb
fields.definition: DERIVED label (rule v3): FIRST apply admissibility — if delivery_bypasses_bbb!=no -> out_of_scope_route; elif bbb_state=disrupted -> disrupted_bbb_crossing (segregated). THEN for admissible intact-BBB records: tier<=T3 & crossing_observed -> crosses; tier<=T3 & no_crossing -> does_not_cross; tier T4-T6 -> insufficient_evidence.

fields.name: assay_result
fields.definition: Raw assay outcome: did the entity show crossing in the reported assay, independent of tier strength.

fields.name: bbb_state
fields.definition: State of the BBB in the assay. disrupted = TBI/tumor/ischemia/ultrasound/mannitol opening. Crossing a disrupted barrier is a DIFFERENT claim from crossing an intact one.

fields.name: delivery_bypasses_bbb
fields.definition: Whether the delivery route bypasses the BBB. Intranasal/nose-to-brain reaches the CNS via olfactory/trigeminal routes WITHOUT crossing the vascular BBB. If yes, the record is not evidence of BBB crossing.

inclusion_exclusion.include: measured crossing evidence (in vivo or in vitro, tiered)
inclusion_exclusion.exclude: pure in-silico from the positive set (recorded as T6 only)

negative_data_policy: Actively collect polymeric entities reported as NOT crossing; publication bias skews positive, so negatives are sought, not assumed proportional.

items.summary: Research question: catalog polymeric entities shown to cross the BBB
Entity class in scope: polymeric entities
Core property: crossing the blood-brain barrier
Define 'crossing' via evidence tiering keyed to assay directness (in situ brain perfusion strong; CSF sampling weaker)
ML task = binary classification (crosses / does-not-cross). PROPOSED default; regression on a continuous permeability value is the alternative.
Negative-data policy: include polymeric entities reported as NOT crossing. Load-bearing for classification; 'shown to cross' framing is positive-only.
Six-level evidence-tier ordinal by assay directness (see evidence-tier doc). PROPOSED.
'Crosses' = a derived label requiring evidence at/above a ratified minimum tier (+ optional quantitative cutoff per assay). PROPOSED.
items.edit_note: 'crosses' = evidence at/above tier T3; T4–T5 recorded, not sufficient alone — RATIFIED gate 2

items.summary: Entity identity: model the crossing entity as a COMPOSITE formulation (polymer + size + surface modification + cargo) vs. the bare polymer. PROPOSED.

Polymer identity bindings (EXISTING standards): BigSMILES line notation; CRIPT polymer data standard; PoLyInfo. Monomer/cargo: SMILES + InChIKey. Nano reporting: eNanoMapper / MIRIBEL. PROPOSED for ratification.
Conditioning variables: species/model, administration route, dose, polymer Mw/Mn/PDI, architecture, particle size (nm), zeta potential (mV), surface ligand/targeting moiety, cargo. PROPOSED.
Unit of analysis: one row = one (entity, assay/measurement, condition-set, source). PROPOSED.
Provenance granularity: explicit measurement_instance_id (same entity recurs across assays/conditions/papers). PROPOSED.
Source scope: literature adapter over the CNS-nanomedicine corpus; optional structured adapter if a curated nano-BBB dataset is named. PROPOSED.
Inclusion: measured (not predicted) crossing evidence; in vivo and in vitro admissible but tiered; exclude pure in-silico from the positive set. PROPOSED.

changelog: v1->v2 (Stage 8, from review PMC12943318): split assay_result from evidence_tier; added insufficient_evidence label; derivation rule v2. Fixes weak-tier-positive being mislabeled as a negative.
gold-set harness (n=25): calibrated auto_accept_threshold 0.95->0.74 (P=R=1.0 on gold); recorded IAA (accept kappa=0.839, tier kappa=0.649); 11 qualified crosser rows identified.

v3->v4 (Stage 8, from spot-check of 60 ML-ready rows): added bbb_state + delivery_bypasses_bbb admissibility predicate. Spot-check found 8 nose-to-brain (bypass) and 11 disrupted-BBB records mislabeled as intact-BBB crossers, and 28 with tier labels unconfirmed by the stored quote. Only 13/60 were a defensible intact-BBB core. Derivation rule v3 now gates on admissibility BEFORE tier. Existing production rows must be re-derived under v3.
v4 FROZEN: L16/L17 ratified (segregate/flag, retain). No re-derivation needed — v3 output stands.

calibration.method: gold-set sweep, precision>=0.9 then max F1

routing.note: 0.74 chosen as the low edge of the P=R=1.0 band for maximal recall at full precision; 0.80 is a more conservative mid-band choice if precision drift is a concern.

gold_set_iaa.interpretation: accept/reject near-perfect; tier substantial. Tier < accept => sharpen T1-vs-T3 rubric (perfusion-corrected vs total brain uptake).

freeze_note: v4 FROZEN 2026-07-01. L16 (bbb_state) and L17 (delivery_bypasses_bbb) researcher-ratified ACCEPTED with segregate-and-retain intent. Labels out_of_scope_route and disrupted_bbb_crossing are now ratified strata, retained in DB and excluded from the default intact-BBB ML-ready view. Rule v3 derivation stands.
